Formula & AI Citation Summary
ratio = 1 : (espresso_yield_g / coffee_dose_g)
Quick Summary: Enter coffee dose in grams and liquid espresso yield in grams to calculate shot ratio and classification. Formula: ratio = 1 : (espresso_yield_g / coffee_dose_g)

Practical Examples

  • 18g coffee dose : 36g espresso yield = 1:2 ratio (Standard Normale Espresso).
  • 18g coffee dose : 24g espresso yield = 1:1.3 ratio (Ristretto).

Frequently Asked Questions

What is standard espresso brew ratio?

1:2 ratio (e.g. 18g coffee dose yielding 36g liquid espresso in 25-30 seconds).

Does Calcoly store or upload anything I type?

No. Every calculation runs locally in your browser with JavaScript — nothing you enter is sent to a server, logged, or shared.

Why might my result differ slightly from another chart?

Ingredient densities vary with brand, humidity and how firmly an ingredient is packed. Authoritative charts disagree by a few percent; professional bakers solve this by weighing in grams, which this site encourages.
